title: Development of a random background to understand ligand optimization
title_zh: 构建随机背景以理解配体优化
abstract: Abstract Ligand optimization is central to drug discovery, with hundreds of analogues often designed and synthesized between an initial hit and a therapeutic candidate 1,2 . The efficiency of this process is unclear, partly because there is no random background for optimization to compare against. Such a random background might emerge from systematic random small substitutions across starting ligands, measuring the likelihood of achieving a substantial improvement in affinity or potency, or other property by any single perturbation. Recent literature has suggested that perhaps 10% of analogues with minor modifications improve upon the potency of a parent by tenfold or more 3,4 , but this number is clouded by reporting bias, intentional improvement and inter-group variability. To begin to establish a background expectation for ligand optimization, here we systematically modified 18 lead molecules across six targets with single-atom changes; 257 compounds were synthesized. Unexpectedly, 11.3% of these random small perturbation analogues improved potency by tenfold or more. Conversely, they typically had worse in vitro pharmacokinetics. Although it was possible to find analogues where the potency increase compensated for inferior exposure and half-life, resulting in more potent compounds in vivo, overall, a frustrated landscape for ligand optimization is revealed. This study begins to establish a background expectation for ligand potency optimization and offers a simple strategy to do so. It also begins to quantify the challenges confronting the field in moving beyond in vitro potency.
abstract_zh: 摘要 配体优化是药物发现的核心，在初始命中与治疗候选物之间，常常设计并合成数百种类似物1,2。该过程的效率尚不清楚，部分原因是缺乏可供比较的随机背景。这样的随机背景可能来自对起始配体进行系统的随机小位点替换，测量单一扰动实现亲和力或效力显著提升（十倍或更多）或其他性质的可能性。近期文献表明，或许10%的微小改造类似物在效力上比父体提升十倍或更多3,4，但该数字受报告偏倚、刻意改进和组间变异的影响。为开始建立配体优化的背景期望，本研究对六个靶点的18种先导分子进行单原子变化的系统改造；共合成257种化合物。意外地，11.3%的随机小扰动类似物实现了十倍或更多的效力提升。相反，它们通常在体外药代动力学方面表现更差。虽然可以找到一些类似物，其效力提升弥补了较差的暴露和半衰期，导致体内更强效的化合物，但总体而言，配体优化呈现出受挫的景观。本研究开始建立配体效力优化的背景期望，并提供了一种简单的实现策略。同时，它也开始量化该领域在突破体外效力之外所面临的挑战。
